Message block

.dr-msg · __title · __body · __actions · .dr-mark · --warn · --danger · components/message.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Live tracking lost We’ve lost the live signal from the operator’s device. Your order is still active.
  1. 1.dr-msgThe block: --card at the 16 radius, padding 22 / 18, gap 12, centred, no shadow.
  2. 2.dr-markThe state mark: 52 × 52 at the 13 media radius, 26px glyph, aria-hidden.
  3. 3.dr-msg__titleWhat happened, at the title step 17/600.
  4. 4.dr-msg__bodyWhat it means for the user, 13/400 in slate, capped at 260px.
  5. 5.dr-msg__actionsThe way out: full-width buttons stacked with gap 10, primary first.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Message block; Empty-state banner.

When to use

One component doing three jobs: the empty state, the error and the notice. It stands on every -empty and -error screen in the set and on the screens that report a delay, from order-history-empty to tracking-error. No empty or error screen is a dead end, so the block always ends on at least one action. The state is told by the mark's glyph and the title, with the wash as a second carrier, never by colour alone. When the empty state carries a picture, it is the banner message.

The copy follows voice.md's state tone. Empty: why it is empty, then one way out. Error: what happened, what it means for the user's order or money, and what to do, with no apology and no joke. The verbs are fixed: Try again to recover, Contact support to reach a person. No Oops, no exclamation marks.

Sources: DESIGN.md § Message block · § State marks · voice.md § Microcopy (Empty state, Error) · P5 · inventory.md § 1.3

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Live tracking lost We’ve lost the live signal from the operator’s device. Your order is still active.

tracking-error: the fact, what it costs (nothing; the order is still active) and two exits. It stays on screen until the user acts, which is why an error lives here and not in a toast.

Don’t

Delivered Your parcel arrived at 10:07.

A success drawn as a message block. Success is a screen of its own, with the milestone well and the display title: use the outcome. For a confirmation of an action that leaves no other trace, use a toast.
